verdict.rationale: GrowthBook lets PMs create experiments on feature flags (including flags with multiple variations for multivariate-style tests), configure goal/secondary/guardrail metrics, and view results via Bayesian/Frequentist engines with 'Chance to Win' win indicators; community reviews corroborate the built-in analysis as a differentiator versus flag-only competitors. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of multivariate (>2 variation) result readouts specifically, and no third-party audit of statistical engine accuracy beyond vendor docs/community praise.
